content: 房間挺小的，房間鑰匙一天一刷，出門還要到前台刷房卡，衹能説真的很麻煩。而且服務態度真的不行啊。倆個人服務一個人，而且我這邊要刷房卡就跟沒聽見似的，而且大堂還開着門熱的要死，説得挺好咖啡免費，還要有會員才能免費，取冰更費勁，去了幾回都沒有冰，這不就是擺設嗎？大夏天的房間的被子太厚了，想要個毯子都沒有，最後沒有辦法衹能用床單跟浴巾。衞生間一股尿騷味。擦了也有味道，還好我們是晚上回去住，要是一天呆屋子裡味道真心受不了，水壺裡麪都是水垢。這衞生環境衹能説，一言難盡啊。想帶孩子住這個位置的還是不建議不太方便，有的地方地鐵要轉3-4趟，出去2個小時坐車。
translatedContent: The room was quite small, and the key card needed to be reactivated daily. We had to go to the front desk to swipe the card every time we left, which was really inconvenient. The service attitude was also really poor. Two staff members were serving one person, and when I asked to swipe my room card, it was like they didn't even hear me. Plus, the lobby door was open, making it scorching hot. They advertised free coffee, but you need to be a member to get it for free. Getting ice was even harder; I went several times and there was never any ice – what's the point of having an ice machine then? The duvet in the room was too thick for summer, and there were no thinner blankets available. In the end, we had no choice but to use the bedsheet and bath towel. The bathroom had a strong urine smell. Even after wiping it down, the smell lingered. Thankfully, we only returned to the room at night; if we had stayed there all day, the smell would have been unbearable. The kettle was full of limescale. The hygiene in general was just awful. I wouldn't recommend this place for families with children, as the location isn't very convenient. Some places require 3-4 metro transfers, and it can take up to two hours to get around.
feedbackContent: 尊敬的賓客，非常抱歉本次入住給您帶來糟糕的體驗，對於遇到的各類問題我們深表歉意。如果是分開預訂訂單，房卡需要每日到前台刷新，給您出行造成不便我們十分理解。前台當時忙於接待其他客人，沒能及時迴應您的需求，我們會加強員工服務培訓，提升響應效率。大堂開門導致室內悶熱，我們會調整門的管控；咖啡機僅對會員免費，標識我們會優化得更加清晰；夏季取冰客人較多，製冰機產出有限，我們也會做好提示。夏季被子偏厚，備用毯子儲備不足，讓您衹能使用床單浴巾將就，我們會增補薄毯物資。針對衞生間異味、燒水壺水垢問題，我們會覆盤客房清潔流程，加強衞生間除味和電器深度清潔。也感謝您客觀提及出行換乘耗時的情況。您的反饋我們全部記錄整改，很遺憾沒能讓您住得舒心，祝您旅途順利。
feedbackTranslateContent: Dear Guest, we sincerely apologize for the unpleasant experience you had during your stay. We deeply regret any issues that arose. If you booked separately, your room key needs to be refreshed at the front desk daily, which we understand caused you inconvenience. The front desk was busy serving other guests and was unable to respond to your needs promptly; we will strengthen staff service training to improve response efficiency. The lobby door being open caused stuffiness in the room; we will adjust door control. The coffee machine is only free for members; we will improve the signage for it. Due to the high demand for ice in the summer, the ice machine's output is limited; we will provide clearer notices. Summer blankets are thicker, and there wasn't enough spare blankets, forcing you to use sheets and towels; we will replenish the supply of thinner blankets. Regarding the bathroom odor and kettle limescale issues, we will review our room cleaning procedures and enhance bathroom deodorization and deep cleaning of appliances. Thank you for your objective mention of the time spent transferring. We have recorded and rectified all your feedback. We regret that you did not have a comfortable stay; we wish you a pleasant journey.
